title: dumpex hunt JSON output (schema_version 1.1)
description: Validates the document written by `dumpex <dump> --hunt <ttp|all> --json <file>`. Scope: meta + hunt sections only -- other commands (--list/--modules/--threads/...) are not covered by this schema. See docs/OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md for the versioning policy. 1.0 -> 1.1: obfuscation's sleep_mask/entropy/base64/xor/compressed/hidden_pe/hidden_shellcode hit shape changed incompatibly (sleep_mask's `offset` used to BE the XOR key rotation value; it is now always 0, with rotation moved to a new `key_offset` field) and is formally defined here for the first time via obfuscationHunterResult -- previously these fields were entirely unvalidated, passing through `additionalProperties: true` on the generic findingHunterResult.

hunt.description: Keyed by TTP name (injection/hollowing/stomping/pipe/cs-beacon/yara/obfuscation). `yara` is routed to yaraHunterResult (it reports matches/rules_hit, not the Finding-object model); `obfuscation` is routed to obfuscationHunterResult (the only Finding-model hunter with additional formally-typed hit fields of its own); every other key -- including any future/renamed hunter -- falls through additionalProperties to findingHunterResult, the generic (and stricter of the two) shape.

hunterResultBase.description: Fields and cross-field invariants common to ALL 7 hunters, regardless of which output model (Finding-based or yara's own matches/rules_hit) they use. Referenced by both findingHunterResult and yaraHunterResult via allOf, never used standalone in `hunt`.

allOf.comment: NOT_EVALUATED must correspond to coverage_status: not_evaluated (when coverage_status is reported at all).
INCONCLUSIVE must never be reported as verdict_level: clean.

DETECTED + coverage_status: partial is explicitly ALLOWED (not constrained here) -- a detection found under incomplete coverage is still a real detection, just one where more may exist beyond what was checked. This clause exists only to document that allowance; it imposes no restriction.

findingHunterResult.description: The 6 Finding-model hunters (injection, hollowing, stomping, pipe, cs-beacon, obfuscation) -- these unconditionally emit confidence/findings/lead_count/review_priority alongside hunterResultBase's fields, verified against each hunter's actual code paths (including their NOT_EVALUATED/early-return branches). additionalProperties stays true because each hunter also reports TTP-specific fields (e.g. cs-beacon.configs, pipe.private_pipes) not modeled here.

yaraHunterResult.description: yara_hunt.py's own matches/rules_hit shape -- only hunterResultBase's fields (status/score/coverage_status/verdict_level) are guaranteed; it does not emit confidence/findings/lead_count/review_priority, so those are not required (and not modeled) here. additionalProperties stays true for matches/rules_hit/scan_complete/coverage and similar yara-specific fields.

obfuscationRegion.description: dumpex.hunt.encoding.models._region_to_dict's output -- a memory region described BY VALUE (never a live object reference, which JSON can't represent reproducibly). State/Protect/Type are the enum's .name string by the time this reaches JSON.

obfuscationHit.description: dumpex.hunt.encoding.models.Hit.to_dict()'s output -- one decoded/classified payload from the sleep_mask, base64, xor, or gzip/zlib layer. `offset` is the byte offset within `region` where the payload starts (always 0 for the whole-region layers: sleep_mask, xor). `key_offset` is sleep_mask's XOR key rotation value (0..key_size-1) -- NOT `offset`, which schema_version 1.0 conflated for sleep_mask hits specifically (a breaking fix, see this schema's own top-level description).

obfuscationEntropyHit.description: dumpex.hunt.encoding.models.EntropyHit.to_dict()'s output -- a statistical observation, never classified/decoded content (no `cls`/`decoded` fields at all).

obfuscationHunterResult.description: The obfuscation hunter (dumpex/hunt/encoding/) -- a findingHunterResult with additional, formally-typed hit-list fields. These are all optional (a clean scan simply omits or empties them), but where present must match the shape above.
